name: 泡泡卡丁车
description: Lap-running 3D kart on a Mobius strip. The resident model is the only source of obstacles: each one is a /v1/systemone decision (a 12-way choice of obstacle kind and lane) placed ahead in real time, with the option letters shuffled, a fresh variation seed and a random pressure point so every decision aims to maximise lap difficulty. The sidebar shows obstacle statistics, kart statistics and the decision variation; every spawn, hit and lap is stored in sqlite.
storage: server sqlite via /v1/apps/kart (games + events + state), localStorage:cwick.kart.v3 fallback
